name: langchain-insumer
summary: LangChain tools for InsumerAPI: condition-based access across 37 blockchains (incl. Tron, Stellar, Sui, XDC, Robinhood Chain). Wallet trust profiles (145 base checks across 27 chains in 9 dimensions, up to 166 across 29 chains in 13), EAS attestations, Gitcoin Passport, Farcaster ID, staking positions, compliance templates, ACP/UCP commerce, domain verification, merchant onboarding, USDC/USDT/BTC/USDT-TRC20 key purchase, and credit management. ECDSA-signed booleans, optional Merkle proofs, 26 tools.
